description: Unit tests for the quiche QUIC simulator, including classes and functions for simulating network components, alarms, packet filtering, and traffic policing.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: A simple actor that increments its value periodically.

classes.name: CounterPort
classes.description: A port that counts received packets and bytes, and per-destination packets.

classes.name: LinkSaturator
classes.description: Simulates a network link that transmits packets at a specified rate to a destination.

classes.name: PacketAcceptor
classes.description: A port that accepts and stores incoming packets.

classes.name: AlarmToggler
classes.description: An actor that toggles a QuicAlarm on and off at specified intervals.

classes.name: CounterDelegate
classes.description: A delegate that counts how many times an alarm fires.

methods.name: Act
methods.description: Performs the actor's scheduled action, such as incrementing counters or toggling alarms.

methods.name: AcceptPacket
methods.description: Accepts a packet into the port, storing or counting it.

methods.name: SetTxPort
methods.description: Sets the transmission port for a link or saturator.

methods.name: GetRxPort
methods.description: Returns the receive port for a link or saturator.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses the activity, e.g., unscheduling transmissions.

methods.name: times_set
methods.description: Returns the number of times an alarm was set.

methods.name: times_cancelled
methods.description: Returns the number of times an alarm was cancelled.
